basics.name: Vidushi Vashishth
basics.label: Software Engineer
basics.summary: Software Engineer at Google with experience building scalable backend infrastructure and security products, and research experience in systems for AI, machine learning, and computational creativity.

work.name: Google
work.summary: Contributed to Security Health Analytics and Cloud Security Insights, building scalable backend infrastructure and customer-facing security capabilities.
highlights: Delivered Simulation APIs for Security Health Analytics' Infrastructure as Code (IaC) Validation feature to detect policy violations in customer test assets. Received a spot award and Customer Empathy award for fast delivery.
Contributed to backend infrastructure for Cloud Security Insights enabled by Security Graph, helping design, build, productionize, and launch the product from scratch. Awarded several peer awards.

Designed, implemented, and scaled scheduling functionality for regular cloud-asset vulnerability scans at configurable intervals, including stopping execution for offboarded customers. Onboarded around 1300 customers without a single scheduling error and received a spot award.

Implemented, productionized, and scaled a custom query editor enabling free-form semantically correct queries for security-related cloud infrastructure context; also improved internal on-call debugging workflows.

work.name: Google
work.summary: Worked on mitigating storage and compute costs in the Play Analytics backend.
highlights: Designed and implemented a multithreaded concurrent data classification and filtering RPC service that was debuggable and could be enabled or disabled, saving 10% of total storage costs.
Awarded a return offer to join full-time.

work.name: Adobe Systems, India
work.summary: Contributed to production and maintenance of backend services for Adobe's Digital Marketing product Campaign.
highlights: Worked on backend services on PostgreSQL, written in C++ for Adobe's Digital Marketing product Campaign.
Delivered independent features for a product used by over 3k customers, collaborating across product management, UI design, and engineering teams.
Contributed to the Reporting service for Product Campaign, used by 35K customer domains and extensively coded in Java.
Identified and reduced security vulnerabilities in a Kafka-based framework using Python, helping uphold GDPR compliance and ensuring zero compliance breaches for European customers.

work.name: Adobe Systems, India
work.summary: Worked on backend and UI technology modernization for Adobe Digital Marketing products.
highlights: Contributed to migration of Adobe Target's colocation project from Apache Sling-based framework to Spring Boot, mitigating bottlenecks and decreasing backend API response time.
Delivered a proof of concept for compatibility between Backbone and React UI components in Target's UI for an upcoming technology stack upgrade.

work.name: Samsung Research Institute
work.summary: Created an image-processing-based Tizen application GUI and optimized backend functionality, reducing backend API response time.
highlights: Awarded a return offer to join full-time post graduation.

work.name: Systems for Artificial Intelligence Lab, Georgia Tech
work.summary: Worked on model checkpoint compression and federated learning research.
highlights: Worked on Inshrinkerator, a novel model checkpoint compression algorithm that traverses the compression and accuracy tradeoff space; achieved up to 39x compression and withstood up to 10 restores with negligible accuracy impact in fault-tolerant training.

Created a novel Federated Learning methodology performing network-adaptive and distributed pruning to better utilize variable per-client network conditions while maintaining comparable accuracy to the baseline model.
Advisor: Prof. Alexey Tumanov. Inshrinkerator paper presented at ACM SOCC, 2024.

work.name: Entertainment Intelligence and Human-Centered AI Labs, Georgia Tech
work.summary: Worked on computational creativity and multimodal AI research.
highlights: Contributed to Creative-Wand, an AI co-creativity transformer-based agent that generates stories guided by user goals and input. Won the best paper at ICCC, 2023.

Worked on hate speech understanding using multimodal attention networks, including PCA on 2048-dimensional ResNet features, computer vision preprocessing and analysis, ensembling, and GradCAM attention visualization.
